description: Arrest counts reported to FBI CDE for the nation, a state, or an agency, summed over a month window from January 1985 through the current year. Returns arrests by offense name, offense category, and detailed offense breakdown, by arrestee sex and race, and by age group for male and female arrestees, with every category CDE reports, zeros included. Each grouping is tallied separately and their sums can differ (arrestee sex and race often total less than the offense groupings), so no grouping stands in for another's total. Narrow to one offense with offense; a code counts one CDE offense breakdown row, which for drug, prostitution, gambling, homicide, human trafficking, and vagrancy codes is part of a larger category. National scope omits identifiers; state requires only state_abbr; agency requires only ori (look it up with fbi_search_agencies). CDE returns zeros both when nothing was reported and when it does not recognize a state or ORI. Set include_monthly for month-by-month arrest counts and rates with population and reporting coverage, which also tells those two cases apart.

from_year.description: Start year of the data range (inclusive), 1985 through the current year. The API uses monthly granularity.

include_monthly.description: Also return monthly: one row per month of the window for the scoped entity, with this selection's counts and rates, population, participating population, and reporting coverage, from CDE's monthly view (one more request).

offense.description: CDE arrest offense code to narrow the counts to, or all (default). A code counts only its own CDE Offense Breakdown row: for a category total use all and read offense_category, and for a category's sex, race, or age breakdown sum its codes. Multi-code categories: Homicide Offenses 11, 12; Human Trafficking 101, 102; Prostitution Offenses 140–143; Drug/Narcotic Offenses 150–160; Gambling Offenses 170–173; Vagrancy/Loitering 300, 330. Every other code is its own category. Codes: 11 Murder and Nonnegligent Homicide; 12 Manslaughter by Negligence; 20 Rape - Not Specified (Legacy); 30 Robbery; 50 Aggravated Assault; 55 Simple Assault; 60 Burglary; 70 Larceny - Theft; 90 Motor Vehicle Theft; 101 Commercial Sex Acts; 102 Involuntary Servitude; 110 Arson; 140 Prostitution and Commercialized Vice (Unspecified); 141 Prostitution and Commercialized Vice - Prostitution; 142 Prostitution and Commercialized Vice - Assisting or Promoting Prostitution; 143 Prostitution and Commercialized Vice - Purchasing Prostitution; 150 Drug Abuse Violations (Unspecified); 151 Drug Sale/Manufacturing (Unspecified); 152 Drug Sale/Manufacturing - Opium or Cocaine or Their Derivatives; 153 Drug Sale/Manufacturing - Marijuana; 154 Drug Sale/Manufacturing - Synthetic Narcotics; 155 Drug Sale/Manufacturing - Other - Dangerous Nonnarcotic Drugs; 156 Drug Possession (Unspecified); 157 Drug Possession - Opium or Cocaine or Their Derivatives; 158 Drug Possession - Marijuana; 159 Drug Possession - Synthetic Narcotics; 160 Drug Possession - Other - Dangerous Nonnarcotic Drugs; 170 Gambling (Unspecified); 171 Gambling - Bookmaking (Horse and Sport Book); 172 Gambling - Numbers and Lottery; 173 Gambling - All Other Gambling; 180 Forgery and Counterfeiting; 190 Fraud; 200 Embezzlement; 210 Stolen Property: Buying, Receiving, Possessing; 220 Vandalism; 230 Weapons: Carrying, Possessing, Etc.; 240 Sex Offenses (Except Rape, and Prostitution and Commercialized Vice); 250 Offenses Against the Family and Children; 260 Driving Under the Influence; 270 Liquor Law Violations; 280 Drunkenness; 290 Disorderly Conduct; 300 Vagrancy; 310 All Other Offenses (Except Traffic); 320 Suspicion; 330 Curfew and Loitering Law Violations.

ori.description: Nine ASCII-letter/digit ORI code (e.g. CA0010400, DCMPD0000); case-insensitive. Find an agency's ORI with fbi_search_agencies. Only permitted and required for agency scope.

scope.description: Geographic scope: national (omit identifiers), state (only state_abbr), or agency (only ori).

state_abbr.description: Two ASCII-letter state abbreviation (e.g. CA, DC, PR); case-insensitive. Only permitted and required for state scope.

to_year.description: End year of the data range (inclusive), 1985 through the current year.

name: fbi_get_arrests

data_last_updated.description: Date CDE last refreshed arrest data; absent when CDE omits it.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `scope_param_missing`: scope is "state" but state_abbr is missing, or scope is "agency" but ori is missing. `scope_param_incompatible`: Identifiers are supplied for a scope that does not apply them. `year_out_of_range`: from_year or to_year is after the current UTC year. `invalid_date_range`: The complete starting year/month is later than the ending year/month. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

female_arrests_by_age.description: Arrests of female arrestees by age group.

from.description: First month of the summed window (MM-YYYY).

male_arrests_by_age.description: Arrests of male arrestees by age group.

max_data_date.description: Latest data month CDE reports (MM/YYYY); absent when CDE omits it.

monthly.description: Present only when include_monthly is true: one row per month of the window for the scoped entity, in chronological order, from CDE's monthly view. Empty when CDE does not recognize the state or ORI.

items.description: One month for the scoped entity.

arrest_count.description: Arrests in the month. In a month whose participated_population is null no agency reported, so the count is not a reported zero.

participated_population.description: Population covered by the agencies that reported for the month; null when none reported.

population.description: Population CDE assigns the scoped entity for the month; null when unavailable.

population_coverage_percent.description: CDE's reporting coverage percentage for the month, never calculated; null when unavailable, as at agency scope.

rate_per_100k.description: Arrest rate for the month. Per 100,000 participating population; null when CDE sends none, including its -1 for a month with no participating population.

notice.description: Present when every count is zero; says whether zeros can also mean an unrecognized state or ORI.

offense.description: Arrest offense code applied, or all.

offense_label.description: What the applied code counts: its CDE Offense Breakdown row when the code is one row of a multi-code category, the category when it is the whole category; "All offenses" for all.

ori.description: Uppercased ORI code; present only for agency scope.

state_abbr.description: Uppercased state abbreviation; present only for state scope.

to.description: Last month of the summed window (MM-YYYY).

title: FBI Get Arrests
